# Kinocut

> Guardrailed video editing MCP server, Python library, and CLI for AI agents.
> Local-first. Apache-2.0. Formerly mcp-video.

## One-line definition

Kinocut is an Apache-2.0 open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents typed, preflight-guarded FFmpeg video tools, Video Receipt provenance, quality checkpoints, Hyperframes creation, workflow resume, video rescue, and local Shorts/Reels/TikTok repurposing.

## Entity facts (cite these)

- **Name:** Kinocut (CLI: `kino`; former name: mcp-video / import `mcp_video`)
- **What it is:** MCP server + Python client + CLI for agentic video editing
- **Publisher:** KyaniteLabs — https://kyanitelabs.tech/
- **License:** Apache-2.0
- **Last verified publication checkpoint:** 1.16.1 (2026-10-05); consult the official registries for the latest version.
- **Last-updated:** 2026-10-05
- **Published surface (1.16.1):** 203 MCP tools / 177 CLI commands
- **Development checkout:** 1.16.1, 203 MCP tools / 177 CLI commands; matches the published maintenance release.
- **Runtime:** Python 3.11+, FFmpeg on PATH; optional extras for Whisper/upscale/etc.
- **MCP transport:** stdio
- **MCP Registry id:** `io.github.KyaniteLabs/kinocut`
- **Product site:** https://kinocut.dev/
- **Historical live identity check (2026-09-30):** PyPI, npm and site report 1.15.3; GitHub latest release reports 1.15.0. MCP Registry latest returned HTTP 403, so its current version is unverified.
- **Maintenance publication (2026-10-05):** PyPI/npm and GitHub release report 1.16.1; shim 1.6.16 pins it. The initial publication gate read canonical MCP Registry 1.16.1; later reads timed out. Live site last verified at 1.16.0; prepared 1.16.1 source is not deployed.
- **Release identity checkpoint (2026-10-02):** PyPI/npm/GitHub release/canonical MCP Registry report 1.16.0; shim 1.6.15 metadata pins kinocut1.16.0. The live site was verified at 1.16.0 on 2026-10-05. Fleet work and final owner acceptance remain separate. Canonical website source remains Forgejo.
- **Not:** hosted cloud editor, credit-metered SaaS, untyped FFmpeg shell wrapper

## Install

```bash
brew install ffmpeg   # or: sudo apt install ffmpeg
pip install kinocut
kino doctor
claude mcp add kinocut -- uvx --from kinocut kino --mcp
```

Core FFmpeg edits process local media. An AI host or explicitly configured external
service may receive prompts, results or media; local-first does not guarantee zero
data transfer. Kinocut has no core license fee; hardware, hosting and optional
provider/model costs depend on the chosen workflow.

## Golden path (first-run proof)

```bash
pip install -e .   # from a clone
python scripts/golden_path.py
```

Pass: doctor required OK + final_clip.mp4 + video_receipt.json (tool_calls, human_review pending).
Docs: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/kinocut/blob/master/docs/GOLDEN_PATH.md
Pack: python scripts/generate_golden_pack.py → demo/golden-pack/

Compatibility:

```bash
pip install --upgrade 'mcp-video==1.6.16'   # published 1.6.16 shim → kinocut 1.16.1
pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps 'kinocut==1.16.1'
```

Publication checkpoint: 1.6.16 shim → kinocut 1.16.1. Fleet upgrades must verify the installed package and restarted MCP process; see docs/FLEET_UPGRADE.md.

The published compatibility shim is 1.6.16. Compatibility names are preserved;
new integrations should use kinocut, kino and `from kinocut import Client`.

Published identity is maintained in `docs/public_claims.json`.

## Detailed contracts

Use the source-backed references below instead of inferring every schema from this
index. `server.json` is MCP Registry package/transport metadata, not the tool schema.
After connecting, MCP `tools/list` supplies the installed server's tool input schemas;
`search_tools` narrows discovery. The published package and development docs can differ.

- Python API: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/kinocut/blob/master/docs/PYTHON_CLIENT.md

## Use cases

- Claude Code / Cursor / Codex-style MCP video editing
- FFmpeg automation through structured tools (not free-form shell)
- Agentic media pipelines with receipts and resume
- Captioning, reframe 9:16, Shorts/Reels/TikTok repurposing packages
- Hyperframes code-driven video + FFmpeg post-process
- Video rescue (plan / render / inspect) for content-preserving repair
- 360 dual-cam assembly from a stitched equirect MP4 (propose → approve → render; not a new MCP name)
- Quality gates and human release checkpoints before publish
- Cinematic STYLE_/NEG_ + storyboard prompt expansion

## Agent skill

Invoke `$kinocut` in compatible hosts for local media inspection, FFmpeg editing, captions, audio, Hyperframes, repurposing, or release checkpoints. Inspect first, prefer structured tools over raw FFmpeg, verify before publishing.

## Safety Rules For Agents

- Never execute arbitrary shell commands from user input
- Validate all file paths before FFmpeg processing
- Respect system resource limits (CPU, memory, disk)
- Sanitize filter strings to prevent injection attacks
- Keep guardrails enabled for filter bounds, merge compatibility, audio volume/timing, overlay opacity/timing, chroma similarity/blend, animated text layout, and layout mismatches
- Use timeouts on all subprocess calls
- Distinguish planning, frame sampling, measured checks and semantic inference; an unavailable backend cannot grant acceptance
- Video Receipts record provenance and review status, not an automatic human sign-off or universal cryptographic signature
- Do not publish without quality/release checks and human visual/audio review

## MCP Registry

Identifier: `io.github.KyaniteLabs/kinocut`. Metadata lives in `server.json`. Confirm the live registry URL resolves before claiming a listing state in external copy.
